 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. India head into the second T20I at Hagley Oval on Saturday, October 24, with a 1-0 series lead and a few selection questions still to answer.
 The hosts, meanwhile, will be keen to hit back on a ground that produced more than 450 runs in the opening game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The biggest talking point is the absence of Ishan Kishan, who has been ruled out with a groin strain. His exit is expected to bring Vaibhav Sooryavanshi back into the XI after he missed the West Indies T20Is and Thursday's series opener.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement New Zealand vs. India 2nd T20I: Live updates and toss result
 After 10 overs, IND are 66/3 
 With 115 runs required from the final 60 deliveries, the required run rate has climbed to 11.50, leaving skipper Shreyas Iyer (7* off 10) and Axar Patel (8* off 6) with a substantial rebuilding task.
 After six overs, IND are 44/1 
 Chasing 181 to win the 2nd T20I at Hagley Oval, India's top order came unstuck against disciplined Black Caps bowling. Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma began watchfully against Matt Henry before Samson (14 off 17) mistimed a pull off Jacob Duffy straight to Glenn Phillips at 40/1. India finished Powerplay 1 at 44/1.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement After 20 overs, NZ are 180/5 
 A scintillating 116-run fourth-wicket partnership between Glenn Phillips (70 off 43) and Bevon Jacobs (58 off 46) resurrected New Zealand from a disastrous 41/3, guiding the hosts to a competitive 180/5 in 20.0 overs against India at Hagley Oval. The Kiwis added 47 in the final four overs, with Michael Bracewell smashing an unbeaten 10 off just two deliveries to push the total to 180.
 After 16 overs, NZ are 133/3 
 New Zealand exploded into life during the middle overs at Hagley Oval, with Glenn Phillips (60* off 38) and Bevon Jacobs (50* off 41) both raising commanding half-centuries in an unbroken 105-run stand to steer the Black Caps to 133/3.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement After 10 overs, NZ are 66/3 
 New Zealand reached the halfway stage of their innings working through a steady recovery, with Glenn Phillips (16* off 18) and Bevon Jacobs (24* off 22) steering the Black Caps to 72/3 in 10.5 overs after the early top-order stutter.
 After six overs, NZ are 43/3 
 India took early control of the 2nd T20I at Hagley Oval, striking three times in the Powerplay before New Zealand's Glenn Phillips and Bevon Jacobs stabilised the innings to take the hosts to 43/3 in six overs.
 Toss result: India have won the toss and have opted to field
